speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify the nature of your pain. Is it located in your lower right abdomen, and does it worsen when you move or cough?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: PID (Pelvic Inflammatory Disease) with possible concurrent Appendicitis or Pyelonephritis given the atypical 5-day duration and severe vomiting, but the dysuria and dyspareunia strongly suggest a sexually transmitted infection causing pelvic inflammation.
